audit: Tier-1 provenance quote fidelity (frozen findings table)

abstract_only.source_text: stored title + abstract (the complete source for this stratum)

fulltext.stratification: OA papers split into 4 quartiles by findings-per-paper, 13 sampled per quartile (2-55 findings/paper)
fulltext.source_text: Europe PMC fullTextXML re-fetched live with Accept: */*, median 6461 normalized words/paper

residual_adjudication.conclusion: All 35 residual quotes are near-misses of real source text, not fabrications: each sits in a paper whose other quotes matched, each shares a contiguous 4-11 word phrase with the source (just under the 12-word threshold), median token-alignment recall 0.917. The 3 LLM OFF_TOPIC calls were false alarms, each mechanically resolved (2 table-cell digit concatenation, 1 inline-citation split).

matcher_bugs_hit.bug_1_merge_fanout: Joining residuals on (pmid, chunk_id) fanned 448 rows to 3852: chunk_id is not unique within a pmid. Fixed with a positional uid + row-count asserts.
matcher_bugs_hit.bug_2_greedy_tag_regex: Standard r'<[^>]+>' consumed plain-text inequalities: '( P < .05). Eight participants...' parsed as one fake tag, deleting whole sentences from 260/1207 abstracts. Fixed by requiring a real tag name and forbidding nested '<'. Moved abstract-only traceable 92.61% -> 99.53%.
matcher_bugs_hit.bug_3_isOA_truthiness: isOA holds 'Y'/'N' strings, not booleans; `isOA==True` selected 0 papers and would have yielded an empty full-text sample.
matcher_bugs_hit.bug_4_partial_token_overlap: Residual diagnostic reported 12-word matches contradicting the 12-shingle test, because substring search matched mid-token ('fx ne' vs 'fx ne orf da'). Made token-aligned; max fell to 11, consistent with the strict matcher.
matcher_bugs_hit.prebuilt_defenses_that_paid_off: tags->space, double html.unescape, NFKD + accent strip, lowercase + non-alnum collapse; plus Greek transliteration and letter/digit splitting so alpha1/α1 and IL-6/IL6 agree.

cross_validation.second_implementation: lxml itertext parse with an independent tokenizer

scope_limits: Stratum 1 is a CENSUS of all 6,535 abstract-only findings; Stratum 2 is a SAMPLE of 851 findings from 52 OA papers out of 29,910 retrieved-fulltext findings (2.8% of that stratum's findings, 4.2% of its OA papers).
Full-text results generalize only to OA papers reachable via Europe PMC; 109 non-OA and 559 unknown-OA papers in that stratum were not auditable offline.
Re-fetched XML is today's version; a genuine quote could mismatch a since-revised article. No mismatch here required that explanation.
14 findings with fulltext_status='blocked' were not audited (no retrievable source text).

Table-cell and figure-caption extractions are structurally unmatchable by a linear-text matcher; 342 findings carry provenance_section='figure/table' corpus-wide and are under-represented in the traceable rate.
This audit tests the COPY path (quote fidelity) only; it says nothing about the RECALL path (ontology identifiers), which prior audits of this corpus found ~28% wrong.
The 12-word shingle threshold is a convention; quotes under 12 normalized words can only be judged by exact substring match (37 such cases across both strata).
verdict: PASS - Tier-1 provenance quotes are genuine source text. 98.09% verbatim-exact / 99.53% traceable on a census of all 6,535 abstract-only findings, and 97.77% / 99.53% on 851 findings re-checked against live Europe PMC full text. Zero fabrications identified; all 35 residuals mechanically explained as near-miss/table/citation artifacts. Consistent with, and slightly better than, the Tier-2 result (94.2% / 98.2%).
